historical_references.reference: Vishnubhai Trivedi was a prominent Indian independence activist and the President of Gujarat Pradesh Congress Committee during the Indian independence movement.
historical_references.context: Vishnubhai Trivedi was born in 1873 and was actively involved in the Indian independence movement. He was a prominent leader of the Indian National Congress in Gujarat and served as the President of the Gujarat Pradesh Congress Committee. He was arrested several times for his involvement in the freedom struggle and was released from prison in 1937 after the British government announced a general amnesty. Vishnubhai Trivedi passed away in 1946.

historical_references.reference: Vishnubhai Patel was a prominent Jain businessman and philanthropist who donated generously to various religious and social causes in Gujarat in the 19th century.
historical_references.context: Vishnubhai Patel was born in 1845 in a Jain family in Gujarat. He was a successful businessman who made his fortune in the textile industry. Vishnubhai Patel was known for his philanthropy and donated generously to various religious and social causes. He funded the construction of several temples, including the Shri Swaminarayan Temple at Khodiyar, and provided financial assistance to various charitable organizations. Vishnubhai Patel passed away in 1911.
